pages.text: A STRUCT declares your own type. Each line in its code block is an element: a name and a type.
$(1)STRUCT point$(br)BEGIN$(br)  x INTEGER$(br)  y INTEGER$(br)END STRUCT$()
A variable of this type is declared as $(1)VARIABLE p STRUCT point$(). Its elements are reached with an index, like $(1)p.x$().

Every program also has a few constants it doesn't declare. $(1)SHEET$() describes its sheet, e.g. $(1)SHEET.number$() and $(1)SHEET.owner$(). $(1)PID$() describes the running process, e.g. $(1)PID.pid$(), $(1)PID.activator$() (who started it) and $(1)PID.x$(), $(1)PID.y$(), $(1)PID.z$() (where its trigger block is). $(1)CURSOR$() describes the cursor right now: $(1)CURSOR.line$(), $(1)CURSOR.function$(), $(1)CURSOR.depth$() and how much of its stack is used, $(1)CURSOR.stack_used$() of $(1)CURSOR.stack_size$(). The names of the errors and of the colors are constants too.
